text:
emma-marketing: Quick check — for the Satellite Summit panel + meetup next month I want to run a 20-min live demo on stage and a follow-up webinar. Goal: capture leads, show our latency/cost benchmark narrative, and route high-intent leads to sales. Thoughts?

jake-sales: Love it. Can we make sure the on-stage demo generates a routable lead (QR -> form) and flags enterprise interest?

sofia-design: For the live demo we should keep visuals minimal. Speaker starts with 1 slide: "Performance delta: default vs. optimized" then switch to the kiosk. I can mock slides + a GIF of the streaming output.

matt-logistics: Swag question — do we want a small take-home card with QR + one-time code, or printed stickers plus big QR on the booth? The card helps attribution.

emma-marketing: Card + QR sounds good. Card will include a short URL + UTM. Also plan a follow-up webinar invite with a deeper benchmark breakdown.

oliver-ops: On the routing side I can wire QR -> Typeform -> Zapier -> our Sales queue, or directly to Airtable webhook. Airtable keeps more metadata. Which do we prefer?

jake-sales: Airtable -> webhook -> sales inbox please. Need a column for "contact_tier" (enterprise/pm/sme) and "demo_interest" boolean. Can the form capture those?

oliver-ops: Yes. Proposed mapping: email, company, role, contact_tier (radio), demo_interest (checkbox), event_code. Webhook payload sample: 

```
{
  "email": "string",
  "company": "string",
  "role": "string",
  "contact_tier": "enterprise",
  "demo_interest": true,
  "event_code": "SAT23-WEB"
}
```

sofia-design: For cards, use a sustainable uncoated stock. Front: 1-line hook + QR. Back: 2 bullet points of benchmark wins (latency down 40%, cost down 2x) + tiny QR code that goes to replay. I'll do a mock.

matt-logistics: Swag order ETA? If we order low-volume cards + 200 stickers + 50 shirts we need to submit by Monday to hit event. Shirt sizes we can limit to L/XL to save budget, but check with ops.

emma-marketing: Budget approved for 50 shirts, 200 cards, 400 stickers. Can we instead do 100 small enamel pins (limited) for high-intent signups? Pins as a scarcity incentive.

jake-sales: Pins for "enterprise" leads only — we can hand out after qualification. Make sure ops doesn't pre-allocate them to booth staff.

oliver-ops: I'll build the Airtable base and a view named "satellite-qualify" that filters contact_tier=enterprise and demo_interest=true. Then add automation to push to Sales Slack channel #sales-inbound with tag.

emma-marketing: Webinar tie-in: we preregister on the card link. After the event send an automated email with webinar invite + 1-pager benchmark. Template draft: short subject, 3 bullets showing the delta, CTA to schedule a deep dive.

sofia-design: Can we get a small animated gif for the social post showing "50ms -> 30ms" with our logo? I can make a 6s loop for reels.

emma-marketing: Yes please. Also need a 2-paragraph benchmark narrative for the follow-up landing page. Keep it customer-focused (e.g., "how we cut inference cost for real-time chat by 2x without quality loss"). Jake can add a quote.

jake-sales: I'll write a short quote about how predictable latency changed conversation flows for customers.

marketing-bot: Reminder: swag request form deadline in 72 hours: https://intranet/requests/swag

matt-logistics: I'll confirm vendor lead times today. If we miss Monday, expedited shipping adds ~3 business days and +$180.

emma-marketing: Action items recap: Sofia mock slides + card by Fri, Oliver build Airtable + webhook by Thu, Matt confirm swag vendor and sizes today, Jake draft quote and qualification rubric by Wed. I'll assemble the webinar invite and landing copy. Anything else?

jake-sales: Add a demo playbook for the booth person: 30s pitch, 90s demo flow, 30s qualifier script. I'll drop a quick doc in #marketing-resources.

sofia-design: I'll post mocks to the thread later.

emma-marketing: Thanks team. If anyone wants to join the stage rehearsal next Tue at 11am ping me. :raised_hands:

marketing-bot: Scheduled: rehearsal reminder for emma-marketing, sofia-design, jake-sales at 2024-11-05T11:00:00Z

oliver-ops: last note: include a fallback QR that links to hosted example output (in case demo kiosk dies). I'll provision a small recording on s3 and update the card link.

emma-marketing: Perfect. Closing thread for now — will post final checklist Friday. :rocket:
